fact: The chair of the House Communications and IT Committee said an integrated AI bill is being prepared by the government with the Ministry of Communications, its features agreed after public consultations, to be taken up by the House after its completion (16 August 2025).
title: رئيس «اتصالات النواب»: الحكومة أعدت مشروع قانون جديد للذكاء الاصطناعي
